title: Tracing Stereotypes from Representation to Output in Multilingual LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.08322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multilingual LLMs show stereotype-related behavior that varies across languages, but behavioral scores do not show where the relevant information is represented or how it affects the output. To investigate these internal mechanisms, we compare linear probing, attribution patching, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and feature ablation in Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-2-9B. Probe performance peaks substantially earlier than attribution in all three models, with a separation of 36-53% of model depth. Retained Llama-Scope features often match the social category on which they were selected and form recurring semantic families, but their lexical alignment and ablation effects vary across SAE suites. Only 6-18% of evaluated residual-stream features have language-agnostic effects under our criterion, and none are category-agnostic. translated_title: 追踪多语言大语言模型中刻板印象从内部表征到输出的传递机制
translated_abstract: 多语言大语言模型表现出随语言而变化的刻板印象相关行为，但行为评分无法揭示相关信息在何处被表征以及它如何影响输出。为了探究这些内部机制，我们在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2-9B三个模型中比较了线性探测、归因修补、稀疏自编码器（SAE）和特征消融方法。在所有三个模型中，探测性能的峰值都显著早于归因分析所定位的位置，两者相差模型深度的36-53%。保留的Llama-Scope特征通常与其被筛选时的社会类别相匹配，并形成反复出现的语义族，但它们的词汇对齐和消融效应在不同的SAE套件之间有所差异。在我们的判定标准下，只有6-18%的被评估残差流特征具有语言无关的效应，且没有任何特征是类别无关的。语言无关特征在Llama-Scope中具有更大的平均消融效应，但这一模式在其他SAE套件中并未重现。
tldr: 本研究结合线性探测、归因修补、稀疏自编码器和特征消融四种方法，在三个多语言大模型中追踪刻板印象信息从内部表征到输出的传递路径，发现表征探测峰值与行为归因位置存在36-53%模型深度的显著分离，且仅有6-18%的残差流特征具有跨语言一致性效应。
en_tdlr: This study traces how stereotype information flows from internal representations to outputs in three multilingual LLMs using linear probing, attribution patching, sparse autoencoders, and feature ablation, revealing that probe performance peaks substantially earlier than attribution (separated by 36-53% of model depth) and only 6-18% of residual-stream features exhibit language-agnostic effects.
